products_options.name: Easy-to-implement
products_options.short_description: With 25 hours of dev, we'll improve your website's UI and UX for better performance and user experience.
products_options.description:
Ways we can help you optimize your website:

Review your current front-end architecture and identify areas for improvement to increase the overall performance and user experience.

Develop custom user interfaces and responsive web designs that ensure seamless experiences across various devices and platforms.

Assist in transforming legacy applications into static site generators and standalone single-page applications (SPAs), enhancing their efficiency and maintainability.

Implement progressive web app (PWA) technologies to offer app-like experiences, offline access, and improved loading times for your website.

Incorporate UI/UX best practices to enhance user satisfaction and interaction with your web app.

Collaborate with your back-end team to ensure seamless integration of the front-end components with the existing infrastructure.

Provide ongoing front-end development support, including regular updates, bug fixes, and integration of new technologies to ensure your website remains up-to-date and achieves its business objectives.

products_options.name: Comprehensive
products_options.short_description: With 50 hours of dev, we'll dive deep into your site's UI and craft a plan for enhanced performance and UX.
products_options.description:
We could use these hours in the following ways to help you optimise your website:

Develop a complete front-end development roadmap that tackles any issues discovered during the website analysis, boosts website performance, and enriches the user experience.

Design and implement custom UI components and responsive web designs that improve your website's visual appeal and user interaction.

Assist with the transformation of legacy applications into modern, efficient static site generators and standalone single-page applications (SPAs).

Implement advanced progressive web app (PWA) technologies to deliver app-like experiences, offline access, and improved loading times for your website.

Collaborate closely with your back-end team to ensure seamless integration of the front-end components with the existing infrastructure and optimize the overall system performance.

Provide ongoing technical support and front-end development services, including regular assessments, updates, ideas, strategies, optimization, and potential new technologies to ensure your website achieves its business objectives.

Establish a comprehensive UI/UX strategy that focuses on accessibility, usability, and user satisfaction, ensuring a positive experience for all visitors.

Provide ongoing technical support and front-end development services, including regular assessments, updates, ideas, strategies, optimisation, and potential new technologies to ensure your website achieves its business objectives.
